title: The Muisca Raft: Context, Materiality and Technology
creator: María Alicia Uribe Villegas, Marcos Martinón-Torres and Juan Pablo Quintero Guzmán
provenance: Published in Pre-Columbian Central America, Colombia, and Ecuador: Toward an Integrated Approach, Dumbarton Oaks, 2021, pp. 275–303; repository copy hosted by University of Cambridge.
notes: Identifies Rodríguez Freyle's version as the most popular among recorded versions and notes his statement that don Juan, cacique of Guatavita, was his informant.
Useful for distinguishing textual transmission from direct event observation.
